description: This is an abstract PHP class 'BaseReader' in the PhpSpreadsheet library, defining a base implementation for spreadsheet data readers. It includes configuration options for reading data only, empty cells, charts, specific sheets, external images, and security scanning. It also provides methods for loading spreadsheets, setting read flags, and managing file access.

classes.name: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Reader\BaseReader
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for spreadsheet file readers, including configuration of reading options, security, and file handling.

methods.name: getReadDataOnly
methods.description: Returns whether only data values should be read, ignoring formatting.

methods.name: setReadDataOnly
methods.description: Sets the flag to read only data values.

methods.name: getReadEmptyCells
methods.description: Returns whether empty cells should be read.

methods.name: setReadEmptyCells
methods.description: Sets whether to read empty cells.

methods.name: getIncludeCharts
methods.description: Returns whether charts in the workbook should be read.

methods.name: setIncludeCharts
methods.description: Sets whether to include charts in reading.

methods.name: getLoadSheetsOnly
methods.description: Returns the list of sheets to load or null for all sheets.

methods.name: setLoadSheetsOnly
methods.description: Sets specific sheets to load by name.

methods.name: getSecurityScanner
methods.description: Gets the security scanner if set.

methods.name: getSecurityScannerOrThrow
methods.description: Returns the security scanner or throws an exception if null.

methods.name: processFlags
methods.description: Configures reading options based on provided flags.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to load spreadsheet from filename.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a spreadsheet from filename with optional flags.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Opens the specified file for reading.

methods.name: setAllowExternalImages
methods.description: Sets whether external images are allowed.

methods.name: getAllowExternalImages
methods.description: Returns whether external images are allowed.
